prompt:
Create ONE original finished background painting for the SECOND room of a whimsical 1993 point-and-click graphic adventure. Use the supplied approved purple McGill lab ONLY as the visual-style reference: match its chunky goofy Day of the Tentacle-inspired hand-inked cel cartoon style, thick dark-plum contours, large simplified shapes, deliberately wonky perspective, expressive crooked architecture, warm custard highlights and bold teal/lilac/orange colour relationships. This is a NEW scene, not a repaint of the university lab. Original imagined NORTEL optical telecommunications equipment test lab, with multiple imposing OME metro optical equipment racks and fibre everywhere. No people or characters, no game UI, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no readable lettering. Landscape exactly 3:2, 1536x1024 composition filling the image edge to edge. Make the room feel like the approved cartoon character could walk straight out of the reference lab and into this one.

Readable functional layout, built as an adventure-game background: giant gently leaning dark teal metal equipment racks occupy most of the back wall. TWO main OME RACKS sit at x29%-48%, y9%-63% and x51%-69%, y7%-64%, with stacked cream/sage card shelves, exaggerated optical connector panels, chunky ventilation grilles, and a few green and amber status lamps. Make a particularly large cream patch shelf at chest height in each main rack, simple broad connector shapes that read at game scale. A third supporting rack partly cropped at the far left x0%-15%, y2%-58% gives the lab depth. Lots of loose YELLOW and tangerine fibre patch leads loop between racks, drape over overhead teal cable ladders, and hang in giant graceful ridiculous loops; they should be playful readable lines, not a photorealistic spaghetti texture. A small wheeled PATCH BENCH sits at the left foreground x3%-27%, y46%-69%, with one conspicuous clean coiled YELLOW SPARE FIBRE lead lying on its top at x10%-23%, y45%-56%, one outsized crimp/tool shape and a squat beige service terminal with green phosphor. On the RIGHT wall, a large skewed CLIPBOARD / CIRCUIT SHEET hangs at x73%-83%, y17%-40%, with an abstract two-box circuit line drawing and some scribbles, NO legible words. At far RIGHT, tall crooked purple/teal EXIT DOOR x85%-99%, y8%-68%, chunky brass handle. Exposed conduits and one giant absurd ventilation duct up top. Keep perspective and rack scale compatible with an adult caricature shown at about half the scene height.

Lower 32%-38% is a broad CLEAR WALKABLE lab floor: warm grey/lilac square raised-floor tiles with oversized crooked seams and muted apricot/custard highlights, mostly free of equipment between x32%-84%, y67%-98%. One or two fibre loops can hug the edge but don't obstruct the central walking area. Foreground floor must give the current sage-shirt character enough space. Cool teal/lilac equipment surfaces, yellow fibre accents, green CRT, warm industrial light, dark plum shadows. Bold cel shading and huge shapes rather than realistic 3D, airbrushing, detail noise, pixel dithering or glossy rendering. Humorous, slightly lopsided, atmospheric and mechanically believable in the same cartoon world as the reference. Leave labels and interactive status to the HTML overlay; output just the complete opaque room artwork.
